headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong AI‑driven gains while others saw modest revenue increases.
summary: Coforge led the pack with 53.6% YoY revenue growth, driven by AI‑centric services. Mid‑tier players like LTM, Tech Mahindra and HCLTech posted solid double‑digit growth, supported by AI and large‑deal wins. Infosys trimmed its FY guidance and grew revenue only 1.5% YoY, reflecting a slowdown. Overall profit growth was mixed, with some firms benefiting from AI revenue spikes.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue expansion
themes.detail: Several companies highlighted AI contributions to top‑line growth, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech’s AI revenue reaching $219 m.

themes.title: Margin pressure at larger peers
themes.detail: Despite revenue growth, firms like Infosys and Wipro saw operating margins under pressure, indicating cost challenges.

leaders.why: Revenue surged 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.

laggards.why: Revenue grew only 1.5% YoY and FY guidance was cut to a 1‑2% range.
